text: Chapter 11: Off to Toram@The Shadow of a Smoky Mountain
■Next Mission\nMove from Vulcani Foothills to\nMt. Vulcani to start.
A large number of herbivorous monsters that are the Eumanos'\nenemies are climbing to the summit of Mt. Vulcani.\nFollow them to find out what they are doing!
Some Eumano soldiers were kidnapped by the herbivorous\nmonsters that are being controlled by Coenubias. Maybe it's\na trap to lure you. Go after them and save the soldiers!
The monsters that kidnapped the soldiers seems to be heading\nto the summit of Mt. Vulcani. Head to the summit while\nbeating the monsters that attack you!
Defeat Oculasignio, a Coenubia monster that is holding the\nEumano soldiers hostage and trying to avenge his fellows!
You found a passage at the summit of Mt. Vulcani that\nextends into the crater. It does not seem like something\nthat forms naturally. Go check it out!
